map.实时预览、纯前端解析、支持常用语法、自动保存草稿: Live preview, front-end-only parsing, common syntax support, automatic draft saving
map.用轻量标记语法编写结构化文档并实时预览。: Write structured documents in a lightweight markup syntax with live preview.

map.写 README 或文档时边写边预览，确认表格、代码块与列表层级渲染正确，再复制: When writing a README or documentation, preview as you type to confirm tables, code blocks and list nesting render correctly before copying into the repository.
map.左侧写 `# 标题` 右侧即时渲染。: Type `# Heading` on the left and it renders instantly on the right.
map.需启用 KaTeX/MathJax 插件。: You need to enable a KaTeX/MathJax plugin.
map.为什么预览里正常、发到别处却乱了？: Why does it look fine in preview but break elsewhere?
map.因为 Markdown 没有统一标准，只有 CommonMark 这类基础规范与: Because Markdown has no single standard — only baseline specs such as CommonMark plus each platform's extensions (GFM tables, task lists, footnotes, math formulas and so on). Extensions supported by this site's preview may not be supported by your target platform. Before publishing, render it once on the target platform, or stick to the most basic syntax.
